description: Return a Mint app link and durable download URL for a chosen model, asset-pack, material, Image, or video/audio artifact, plus filename/content type/format metadata. Requires ownership, a ready asset, and download permission. Use mintUrl to open the asset in Mint, and use downloadUrl directly for curl, image loaders, R3F loaders, browser audio, or game runtime code. The URL does not expose raw provider URLs, storage keys, provider job IDs, or Trigger IDs.
name: get_asset_artifact
title: Get Asset Artifact
